description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService class, which provides methods for managing employee immigration records such as retrieval, saving, deletion, and searching. It interacts with a Data Access Object (DAO) for database operations and is part of a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordService
classes.description: Service layer class providing business logic for employee immigration record management, including CRUD operations and search functionality.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the DAO object used for database interactions related to employee immigration records.

methods.name: setEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object, allowing for dependency injection or mocking in tests.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific immigration record for an employee by employee number and record number.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves all immigration records associated with a specific employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee immigration record in the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes multiple immigration records for an employee based on sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Returns a list of immigration records matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immigration records matching search filter parameters.
